name: Surprise — Set Surprise
summary: Repeat one motion several times to build arousal, then switch to an entirely different type just before it becomes predictable—combining buildup time with anti-predictability.
detailed_description: Set surprise balances buildup and variety. Use one consistent motion for a few repetitions so arousal can build, then—right before boredom or predictability sets in, and before the orgasm itself starts—switch to a different type of stimulation. As Sonya describes it, what feels best is a mix of different moves but each one happening a few times. This gives the build time that constant surprise can lack while still avoiding routine.
stepwise_structure: 1. Pick a motion that's working and repeat it a few times to build arousal.
2. Let the building phase develop—don't switch too early.
3. Just before it becomes predictable (and before orgasm begins), switch to an entirely different type of stimulation.
4. Repeat the new motion a few times, then switch again—avoid a fixed, predictable switching pattern.
5. Once orgasm is building, stop switching and stay consistent with one motion.
safety_notes: Don't switch so often that arousal never builds; give each set a few repetitions.
Hold consistency once the orgasm is building rather than introducing new sets.
